assets.prompt: Create a single transparent-background historical strategy game building sprite of the ORIGINAL Henry House at First Manassas in July 1861. Use the attached actual 1861 drawing as the architectural reference: very modest weathered gray horizontal wood-clapboard one-and-a-half-story farmhouse, steep side-gabled brown shingle roof, exposed broad gable end with vertical boarding and small upper window, brick chimney toward the far gable, simple rectangular massing, small lower windows and plain doorway in long side. Do not depict the larger postwar replacement house. Show house standing shortly before the destructive bombardment, weathered but intact, no exaggerated holes. Isometric three-quarter overhead camera about 45 degrees down, long side and gable end both visible, physically believable painted realism, desaturated earthy tones, soft daylight from upper left, crisp readable details at small game scale. House alone, compact soft contact shadow, transparent background, no ground tile, no vegetation, no people, no text, no border. Centered with 12 percent empty transparent margin. Architecture should faithfully follow reference massing while perspective is changed for the game.

The historic landmark is a substantial two-story pale gray limestone Federal/Adam-style house with a central entrance, sash windows, projecting bays and a side dependency; preserve the distinctive front massing shown in the sign's illustration. Modest weathered dark shingle roofs and chimney stacks, no grand plantation fantasy. High bird's-eye orthographic camera about 65 degrees down, front faces image bottom, principal walls aligned horizontally and vertically (no diagonal isometric rotation). Roof and upper front facade visible. Detailed painterly realistic miniature, soft daylight from upper left; match a rural timber farmhouse sprite in the same tactical game. ONE building only, centered, completely visible, fills about 75% of 1024x1024 canvas, generous genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha margins. No grass tile, background, figures, trees, furniture, flags, fences, smoke, captions, text, sign or border. Tight subtle contact shadow only. Architectural reconstruction is illustrative where the photo is ambiguous.
